title: Access Control
description: Restrict who can respond to this form

requireSignIn.title: Require sign-in to respond
requireSignIn.description: Respondents must sign in with Google or a one-time email code before they can fill out this form

allowedDomains.title: Restrict to email domains
allowedDomains.description: Only respondents with a verified email on one of these domains can respond
allowedDomains.label: Allowed domains

validation.invalidDomainMessage: "{{domain}}" doesn't look like a valid domain (e.g. "example.com")

collectEmail.title: Collect respondent email addresses
collectEmail.description: Ask respondents to sign in with Google or a one-time email code so you can see who submitted each response — without restricting who can respond
collectEmail.impliedByRequireSignIn: Already collected because sign-in is required above

saveProgress.title: Let respondents save and resume
saveProgress.description: Answers are saved automatically while respondents fill out the form, so they can continue later on any device. Drafts are private to each respondent, never appear in your responses, and are deleted 30 days after their last change.
saveProgress.descriptionOptionalSignIn: Answers are saved automatically while respondents fill out the form, so they can continue later on any device. Forms that don't require sign-in show an optional "Sign in to save your progress" prompt. Drafts are private to each respondent, never appear in your responses, and are deleted 30 days after their last change.

oneResponsePerRespondent.title: Limit to one response per person
oneResponsePerRespondent.description: Each signed-in respondent can submit once. When they come back, they can view their earlier response instead of filling the form again.

allowRespondentEdit.title: Let respondents edit their response
allowRespondentEdit.description: Respondents can change their latest response after submitting. Every change is recorded in the response's edit history.
allowRespondentEdit.unavailableForQuiz: Not available on quizzes, because an edit would no longer match the grade.
